title: Gold Plus Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies Gold Plus Account requirements: open with a minimum $10,000, maintain at least a $25,000 minimum balance, and notes interest compounds daily. It also states an automatic sweep threshold of $50,000 (end-of-day available balance) and a monthly withdrawal limit of 25 withdrawals.
